KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T3_HADITHI.MIGHANI.M8_FSI.feedback: "Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni" ni mighani: ushujaa na ulinzi wa jamii huheshimiwa.

example.question: Hadithi ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?

KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T3_HADITHI.MIGHANI.M8_FSI.help: Ask: who first made it, and how was it passed on? By mouth, from one generation to the next.

KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T3_HADITHI.MIGHANI.M8_FSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Ujumbe wa "Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni" ni upi?
example.wrong_answer: Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni
example.correct_answer: ushujaa na ulinzi wa jamii huheshimiwa.

KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T3_HADITHI.MIGHANI.M8_FSI.cause: Copying a line feels like a safe answer.

KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T3_HADITHI.MIGHANI.M8_FSI.help: Close the text; say the lesson in your own words.
KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T3_HADITHI.MIGHANI.M8_FSI.feedback: Ujumbe ni funzo kwa maneno yako mwenyewe.
KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T3_HADITHI.MIGHANI.M8_FSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.error: Takes a tamthilia for another kind of text (novela) or gives the features of the other kind.

example.question: Ni sifa ipi ni ya tamthilia?
example.correct_answer: huandikwa kwa mazungumzo ya wahusika ili iigizwe jukwaani

KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.cause: The child has met several kinds of literature and keeps one list of features for all of them.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.reveals: The question "Ni sifa ipi ni ya tamthilia?" with "husimuliwa na msimulizi bila mazungumzo" among the options.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.help: Lay a tamthilia and a novela side by side and list what only the tamthilia has.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.feedback: Tamthilia huandikwa kwa mazungumzo ili iigizwe.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.error: Calls a tamthilia oral literature (fasihi simulizi) because it can be read aloud or acted.

example.question: Tamthilia ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?

KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.cause: Plays are acted and poems are recited, so the child thinks of them as spoken.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.reveals: The question "Tamthilia ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?" with "fasihi simulizi" among the options.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.help: Ask: was it first composed in writing by a known author? Then it is fasihi andishi, even when performed.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.feedback: Tamthilia ni fasihi andishi: imeandikwa na mwandishi anayejulikana.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.error: Gives one feature only (length, or rhyme) as the whole meaning of a tamthilia.

example.question: Eleza maana ya tamthilia.
example.correct_answer: ni kazi ya fasihi andishi iliyoandikwa kwa mazungumzo ili iigizwe jukwaani

KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.cause: The child remembers the most visible feature.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.reveals: The question "Eleza maana ya tamthilia." with "ni mchezo" among the options.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.help: Build the definition from three parts: what kind of text, its form, its purpose.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.feedback: Maana kamili ya tamthilia hutaja aina yake, muundo wake na lengo lake.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.error: Takes the narrator or a character for the author of the tamthilia.

example.question: Ni nani mwandishi wa "Kilio cha Msitu"?

KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.cause: The narrator speaks as "I" and the child takes that voice for the writer.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.reveals: The question "Ni nani mwandishi wa "Kilio cha Msitu"?" with "Bi. Zuhura" among the options.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.help: Find the author's name on the cover; the narrator and characters are inside the story.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.feedback: Mwandishi ni mtunzi; msimulizi na wahusika ni sehemu ya kazi.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.TAMTHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.error: Puts several ideas in one paragraph, or one idea across many tiny paragraphs, so no idea is built up.

example.question: Aya nzuri ya insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji" ina nini?
example.correct_answer: wazo moja kuu linalokuzwa kwa maelezo na mifano

KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.cause: Paragraphs are made where the child pauses, not where an idea ends.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.reveals: The question "Aya nzuri ya insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji" ina nini?" with "mawazo mengi tofauti" among the options.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.help: Topic sentence first; then two or three sentences that develop only it; a link to the next paragraph.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.feedback: Kila aya ikuze wazo moja kuu.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.error: Plans with points (vidokezo) that do not belong to the title, or writes the insha without using the points planned.

example.question: Ni kidokezo kipi hakifai kwa insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji"?

KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.cause: The child lists whatever comes to mind and does not check each point against the title.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.reveals: The question "Ni kidokezo kipi hakifai kwa insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji"?" with "Bei ya sukari imepanda dukani." among the options.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.help: Write the title at the top of the plan; tick each point only if it helps to tell that story.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.feedback: Kila kidokezo kinapaswa kusaidia kusimulia kisa cha anwani.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji"?
example.wrong_answer: walinzi walimwongoza mtoni, wanakijiji waliogopa, alifika kijijini, tembo alikosa maji
example.correct_answer: tembo alikosa maji, alifika kijijini, wanakijiji waliogopa, walinzi walimwongoza mtoni

KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji"?" with "walinzi walimwongoza mtoni, wanakijiji waliogopa, alifika kijijini, tembo alikosa maji" among the options.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza mengi kuhusu jambo hili.

KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
KISW.G8.KUANDI.T3_INSHA_ZA_KUBUNI.KUBUNI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI.VIW_MILIKI.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

KISW.G8.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI.VIW_MILIKI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.error: Starts or ends without the opening or closing formula (Paukwa!).

KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.reveals: The question "Msimulizi anaanzaje?" with "anaanza moja kwa moja na kisa" among the options.
KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.help: Practise the formula with the class answering.
KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.error: Presents in one flat voice, with no change for characters or feelings.

example.question: Unapowasilisha, sauti yako iweje?

KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.cause: The child is shy and keeps the voice safe.
KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.reveals: The question "Unapowasilisha, sauti yako iweje?" with "moja tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho" among the options.
KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.help: Give each character a voice; rehearse one line in each.
KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.feedback: Badilisha sauti kulingana na mhusika na hisia.
KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.error: Uses no gestures, or gestures that do not match the words.

example.question: Ni ishara ipi inafaa unapotaja "mlima mrefu"?

KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.cause: The body is forgotten under the stress of remembering words.
KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.reveals: The question "Ni ishara ipi inafaa unapotaja "mlima mrefu"?" with "kushika kichwa" among the options.
KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.help: Mirror pairs: one says, one shows; swap.
KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.error: Presents to the floor or the teacher only, with no eye contact and no call for responses.

example.question: Unawasilisha mbele ya darasa. Unawaangalia nani?

KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.cause: Reciting for marks is done to the teacher.
KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.reveals: The question "Unawasilisha mbele ya darasa. Unawaangalia nani?" with "chini au mwalimu peke yake" among the options.
KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.help: Divide the room into three; look at each part in turn.
KISW.G8.KUSIKI.T4_HADITHI.VISASILI.M8_FS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Wakulima walichimba mitaro ili kuhifadhi maji ya mvua."?
example.wrong_answer: Wakulima ... walichimba ... mitaro ... ili ... kuhifadhi ... maji ... ya ... mvua.
example.correct_answer: Wakulima walichimba mitaro ili kuhifadhi maji ya mvua.

KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Wakulima walichimba mitaro ili kuhifadhi maji ya mvua."?" with "Wakulima ... walichimba ... mitaro ... ili ... kuhifadhi ... maji ... ya ... mvua." among the options.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Time two readings: one very fast, one at speaking pace; listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, tutaacha misitu yetu iangamie?" inasomwa vipi?

example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G8.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, tutaacha misitu yetu iangamie?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
